claims: Scottie Scheffler won the 2024 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler's 2024 win marks his second green jacket in three years.
Jon Rahm won the 2023 Masters.
Hideki Matsuyama won the 2021 Masters.
Tiger Woods won his fifth Masters title in 2019.
Jack Nicklaus holds the record with six Masters wins.
Tiger Woods has five Masters wins.
Scottie Scheffler won the 2022 Masters.
Dustin Johnson won the 2020 Masters.
Patrick Reed won the 2018 Masters.
Sergio Garcia won the 2017 Masters.
Danny Willett won the 2016 Masters.
Jordan Spieth won the 2015 Masters.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters in 1963, 1965, 1966, 1972, 1975, 1986.
Tiger Woods won the Masters in 1997, 2001, 2002, 2005, 2019.
Arnold Palmer won the Masters in 1958, 1960, 1962, 1964.
Jimmy Demaret won three Masters.
Sam Snead won three Masters.
Gary Player won three Masters.
Nick Faldo won three Masters.
Phil Mickelson won three Masters.
Only three players have won back-to-back Masters.
Jack Nicklaus won back-to-back Masters in 1965–1966.
Nick Faldo won back-to-back Masters in 1989–1990.
Tiger Woods won back-to-back Masters in 2001–2002.
The Masters Tournament was not played from 1943 to 1945 due to World War II.
Dustin Johnson set the lowest score relative to par of -20 in the 2020 Masters.
